description: Start or reuse one checklist's playlist: its requirements, with its school's policy, set out as an ordered sequence of lines. It needs a saved school policy and names playlist_policy_open as the next call when there is none. Answers hit (the stored playlist, its playlist_id and status), or stale or miss with a manifest of sections to read with playlist_read: stored_rows, requirements, requirements_html, courses, one linked:<capture_file> for each page the requirement section links to that the cabinet holds, and policy. Links the cabinet does not hold are listed by URL. On stale it also returns the stored playlist. You read the sections, reason over them yourself, and send the lines with playlist_save. On stale or miss the answer also carries procedure, a numbered list of steps that is the same for every caller, and procedure_version: follow the steps in their order; and area_lines, the area names the school's checklists use, each a query for playlist_find_pages. A stored playlist that was built under a school policy that is no longer the one in use is out of date: the answer is stale, with policy_rebuilt true and the sections to rebuild it, and a new build that passes takes its place whatever its trust. Where the checklist's only playlist was rejected, the answer is a miss that says so: rejected is playlist, and trust has state rejected with its sentence. Every answer carries verified: true only when a run of the stored playlist would be verified, that is when the playlist's trust state and its school policy's are both ai_verified or school_confirmed; false where no playlist is held. Read verified; do not work it out from the state. Every answer carries trust: the playlist's trust state, who built it and when, who verified or confirmed it and when, its catalog edition, the school policy's state, and one sentence. Always tell the person the trust statement. A playlist's status (draft, rejected or superseded) is its save lifecycle only; its trust_state is how far it can be trusted: published_only, unverified, ai_verified, school_confirmed, needs_rereview or rejected. mapped_from says what the answer is from: playlist, with its playlist_id and trust state, or harvested_checklist.
